blocking_findings_definition: Confirmed integrity violations that invalidate the qualified completed-pair comparison. An empty list does not certify missing evidence, satisfy the user goal, accept a model promotion or approve another launch.

limitation_findings.title: Raw normal evaluation rows are unavailable locally
limitation_findings.details: All six native_rows_epoch000/001/002.jsonl files have recorded hashes and sizes, but no local row payload was available. Diagnostic arithmetic and native counts were cross-checked; individual boxes, IoUs, input fingerprints, unique expression IDs, and cross-arm equality were not independently recomputed. Logged assertions are not an independent raw-row recount.

limitation_findings.title: Dataset payload provenance is source-traced, not payload-rehashed
limitation_findings.details: GT flows from ScanRefer object IDs and original ScanNet object segment points into center_label, size_gts and gt_masks. The actual filtered annotation JSON/TXT, cached train/val_v3scans.pkl, scan point/aggregation payloads and split membership were not supplied for an independent data-byte audit. Exact scene counts and annotation identity were not recounted. The reviewed native protocol is not independently certified as identical to an external official-paper protocol.

limitation_findings.title: Seventeen unique staged dependencies lack matching local bytes
limitation_findings.details: The 240-entry two-arm stage manifest has 206 entries bound to matching local bytes; 34 entries represent 17 unique unavailable dependencies. These include models/encoder_decoder_layers.py, models/modules.py, ScanNet metadata/split files, parser word lists, a figure and the pointnet2 binary. Other local copies of the two Python files had different hashes and were not substituted. Exact expected hashes and remote paths are preserved in SOURCE_HASH_BINDINGS.json. Shared manifests establish historical hash agreement, not current independent inspection of these missing bytes.

limitation_findings.title: No cold recovery or serialized trained optimizer counter audit
limitation_findings.details: Two complete epochs and one optimizer/scheduler step per loop imply 9166 step calls per arm. No normal checkpoint was loaded, and trained optimizer step counters, scheduler recovery, RNG restoration and cold native restart were not verified. M0 exercised two updates and same-process recovery only; it cannot establish normal recovery. Retained E0 archives contain zero optimizer state entries, so they do not prove trained optimizer recovery.

limitation_findings.title: Normal E0 outputs are not bitwise identical in saved diagnostics
limitation_findings.details: Both arms have the same E0 native hits 5677/4920, and supplemental E0 tensor manifests agree across 1295 tensors. However E0 row hashes/sizes differ and raw_below_zero_by_axis is [198202,211220,167258] for final_duplicate versus [198201,211221,167257] for coarse_endpoint. The cause is not established without row data; equal totals and model manifests must not be promoted into identical forward-output evidence.

limitation_findings.title: One seed, one validation dataset, two trained epochs per arm
limitation_findings.details: Seed 2027 is the only paired normal run. The protocol allowed up to eight epochs; both actually stopped at two. This supports a bounded within-protocol comparison, not multi-seed robustness, an eight-epoch completed comparison, test generalization, Nr3D/Sr3D results, or a verified independent third mechanism. M0 and observed normal responsibility records do not demonstrate non-root matched-target coverage, although the source retains generic original targets.

limitation_findings.title: Original remote state and full logs were not revisited
limitation_findings.details: This is a local cached-evidence audit. Both original normal paths, native statuses, exits and captured intake hashes were checked. Only 20000-byte train-log tails are available for each normal arm, not the full original logs. The current remote filesystem, runtime process history and original remote payloads were not independently rehashed.

limitation_findings.title: Archive receipts support content identity with explicit limits
limitation_findings.details: The independently read control/coarse archive receipts and 1295-entry model manifests agree at E0. Both reconstructed local best.pth paths exist at 614926031 bytes. Their checkpoint payloads were not loaded or rehashed by this reviewer. They are content reconstructions, not original ZIP-byte copies. The historical control source C:\Users\gb\.codex\archives\pvg_native_normal_20261010\best.pth is currently absent; the E-drive control reconstruction is currently present and is named as the coarse reconstruction source. This does not establish identical forwards, raw rows, or trained-state cold recovery.

limitation_findings.title: Fresh reviewer route is same-family and actual model is unattested
limitation_findings.details: A fresh native reviewer task was requested with fork_turns=none, model=gpt-6-astra and reasoning_effort=max. The returned task identifier does not attest actual backend model/effort. Both actual fields remain UNATTESTED. The semantic review is same-family/provisional; deterministic file and arithmetic checks have their own recorded outcomes.

claim_acceptance_blocks.detail: Retained 5677/4920 < current 5724/4945; no single complete model meets the user goal.
Best trained coarse is +1/-178 versus retained E0; small paired-control differences do not establish an effective new mechanism.
L01-L05/L07-L09 prevent raw, full-source, cold-recovery or cross-family acceptance claims.
